_comment: job_name -> CRON_AGENT_SKIP_IF_UNCHANGED fingerprint command, read by cron-agent.sh's run_agent() when the env var itself is unset (FINGERPRINT_MAP, see wrappers/cron-agent.sh). Arms P2 no-op suppression (PR #4108) without editing any of the ~16 crontab lines that invoke cron-agent.sh — merging this file (once deployed to $HOME/.cron-agent/fingerprints.json on Pro, same HOME-fork deploy step as cron-agent.sh itself) is the whole arming action. An explicit CRON_AGENT_SKIP_IF_UNCHANGED env var on a crontab line still overrides this per-job. Every command here is fail-open by construction (see wrapper comment): empty stdout or non-zero exit -> agent runs, never skipped. Only jobs with a real, cheap, deterministic notion of 'is there new input' belong here — see PENDING-ARMS / the 2026-08-12 fingerprint audit for the NON-ARMABLE and GIA-GRATIS jobs deliberately left out (learning-pipeline: no file input at all, by design; cell-weekly-report and nlm-nb1-daily-refresh: exec tier, never reaches this code path; conversation-cleanup, seo-guardian-observe: disabled, not live).
weekly-dep-audit: cd "$HOME/Desktop/nuzantara/apps/backend-rag" && source .venv/bin/activate 2>/dev/null; pip list --outdated --format=json 2>/dev/null; cd "$HOME/Desktop/nuzantara" && npm audit --json 2>/dev/null | jq -c '.metadata.vulnerabilities // {}' 2>/dev/null
seo-guardian-weekly: D="$HOME/.openclaw/workspace/autonomous/seo-guardian"; C="$HOME/Desktop/nuzantara/apps/evaluator/coverage_state.json"; stat -f '%m %z' "$D/state.json" "$D/patterns.json" "$C" 2>/dev/null; wc -l < "$D/memory.jsonl" 2>/dev/null; sqlite3 "$HOME/Desktop/nuzantara/data/seo_cell/seo_cell.db" 'SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM episodes),(SELECT count(*) FROM ltm),(SELECT count(*) FROM stm);' 2>/dev/null
indexing-daily: cd "$HOME/Desktop/nuzantara" || exit 9; command -v jq >/dev/null || exit 9; kt=$(jq '.data|length' apps/mouth/data/KBLI_2025_FINAL_CLEAN.json) && kd=$(jq '(.submitted|length)+(.failed|length)' apps/evaluator/indexing_state.json) && at=$(find apps/mouth/src/content/articles -name '*.mdx' 2>/dev/null | grep -v sync-conflict | wc -l | tr -d ' ') && ad=$(jq '(.submitted|length)+(.failed|length)' apps/evaluator/articles_indexing_state.json) || exit 9; kp=$((kt-kd)); ap=$((at-ad)); if [ "$kp" -le 0 ] && [ "$ap" -le 0 ]; then echo caught-up; else echo "backlog-$(date +%Y%m%d)"; fi
